variants.text: The bars are on the outside and they were shut before the sand came. You could lift one — but you would want to know what the dune did first, and there is exactly one record of where these dunes have been.
Barred from the street, every one, and the sand piled against them afterwards. Somebody shut this town and then the desert agreed with them.
A town two hundred years too young for the dune that had it. You would want the chart before you started lifting bars.
